fieldNameMapping.description:
A mapping of the form field names to the required field names used for the connection. For example, the `username`
field from the form in the UI may need to be mapped to the `credentials.username` field for a JDBC connection.

sharedValues.description:
A mapping of shared default values for the configuration.
For example, the `sharedValues` should include `sourceSystemType`, which would be set to `SqlSourceSystem` or other SourceSystem.

title: Configuration for a data connector and how the form fields correspond to the required fields used for the connection.
name: SelfServiceDI.Ui.DataConnectorCredentialConfig
